basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old avid Pokémon fan living in Toronto, Canada. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my passion for gaming and trading Pokémon. I've been collecting Pokémon cards and playing the games since childhood, and now, I frequently hunt for shiny Pokémon. I'm also a big fan of metal music, particularly Cryptopsy, and enjoy playing support roles in League of Legends, especially with Soraka. I have a love-hate relationship with cilantro and actively participate in communities that share this sentiment. Most of my online activity happens late at night, usually between 10 PM and 2 AM. Currently single, I enjoy going to live gigs and exploring entrepreneurial ideas in my spare time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep knowledge of the Pokémon universe, cultivated from years of playing the games and engaging with the community. My expertise extends to the mechanics of shiny hunting and event Pokémon, often self-taught through online resources and community interactions. Additionally, I have a keen interest in music, particularly metal, and have a wealth of knowledge about the genre and its subcultures.
